research_question: How do migratory birds navigate over long distances?

sources.title: Navigation: How Birds Find Their Way When They Migrate
sources.publisher: Cornell Lab of Ornithology, All About Birds
sources.reliability: University ornithology research and education organization
notes: Birds can use sun position, stars, polarized light, landmarks and magnetic cues; the mix differs by species and context.

sources.title: Migration
sources.publisher: Cornell Lab of Ornithology, All About Birds
sources.reliability: University ornithology research and education organization
notes: Migration is shaped by seasonal food, breeding opportunities and inherited or learned orientation; routes and strategies vary widely.
